news.headline: Indian bonds track US Treasuries higher amid oil-price relief
news.summary: Indian government bonds increased on Thursday due to support from a rally in Treasuries and lower oil prices. However, the upcoming large bond sale and a weak rupee limited the extent of the gains observed. The benchmark 6.94% 2036 bond yield fell slightly below the significant 7.40% level during early trading hours. Meanwhile, the Reserve Bank of India previously raised the repo rate amid ongoing inflation concerns.

news.headline: Global Market: Japan's Nikkei rises on Advantest forecast; Samsung slump caps gains
news.summary: Japan’s Nikkei rose 0.3%, supported by Advantest’s 5.4% rally after it raised its full-year operating profit forecast by 14%. However, declines in technology stocks and an 8.7% fall in Hitachi limited gains. Investors remained cautious ahead of Japan’s earnings season and the Bank of Japan’s policy decision.

news.headline: Global Market: Japan bond yields steady ahead of BOJ policy decision
news.summary: Japanese government bond yields remained largely steady ahead of the Bank of Japan’s policy decision on Friday, supported by strong demand at a two-year bond auction and gains in US Treasuries. Markets expect the BOJ to hold rates steady, while a Reuters poll points to a possible 25-basis-point hike in December.

news.headline: Michael Burry says Anthropic IPO papers show AI industry is 'catastrophically vulnerable'. What the 'Big Short' investor sees
news.summary: Investor Michael Burry warned that Anthropic’s planned IPO exposes serious vulnerabilities in the AI industry, citing massive infrastructure commitments, slowing growth and mounting costs. The investor, known for predicting the 2008 financial crisis, believes disappointing AI revenues could trigger a significant market correction and capital losses.

news.headline: Adani group stocks jump up to 3%, add Rs 23,000 crore to total m-cap. What’s behind the surge?
news.summary: Adani Group stocks rose on Thursday, adding Rs 23,000 crore to their combined market capitalisation, as Q2 results and bullish brokerage calls lifted sentiment. Adani Power reported a 134% jump in net profit, while Jefferies raised its target price for Adani Ports and sees significant upside in Adani Enterprises.

news.headline: Jupiter Wagons shares rally 8% on Rs 1,140 crore Railway Board order
news.summary: Jupiter Wagons shares rallied over 8% after securing a Rs 1,140 crore Railway Board order for 2,583 wagons. The company expects additional order inflows of around Rs 2,000 crore in Q4 FY27, supported by government and private-sector demand. Despite the gains, the stock has fallen 25% in three months and trades below seven of its eight simple moving averages.

news.headline: Global Market: China’s yuan hits four-year high against dollar after Fed holds rates
news.summary: China’s yuan climbed to a four-year high against the US dollar, supported by the central bank’s firm guidance and the Federal Reserve’s decision to hold interest rates steady. The People’s Bank of China continued managing appreciation, while investors awaited the European Central Bank’s policy decision for further currency market direction.

news.headline: Potential LTCG tax cut could revive FIIs’ India bet, says Jefferies: Which stocks may benefit most?
news.summary: Jefferies sees a potential long-term capital gains tax (LTCG) cut as a possible trigger for foreign investors to return to Indian equities after record outflows. Banks, Reliance Industries, utilities and real estate stocks could be the biggest beneficiaries. Here’s where foreign investors are positioned and what a tax cut could mean.

news.headline: Antala Industries SME IPO opens today: Check price band and key details
news.summary: Antala Industries’ Rs 23.33 crore SME IPO opens on October 29, 2026, and closes on November 2. Priced at Rs 63–67 per share, the fresh issue will fund working capital, machinery purchases and general corporate purposes. The packaging manufacturer reported strong FY26 growth, with total income rising 49% and profit after tax increasing 133%.

news.headline: Adani Ports shares rise 3% after Q2 results. Why did Jefferies and Nomura raise target prices?
news.summary: Adani Ports shares rose after the company reported strong Q2 FY27 earnings and raised its full-year guidance. Jefferies and Nomura increased their target prices, citing robust international port performance, higher earnings estimates and long-term growth prospects.

news.headline: HDFC Bank Share Price Live Updates: HDFC Bank's Performance Overview
Bombay Coated & Special Steels IPO opens today; GMP at 11%. Should you subscribe?
news.summary: Bombay Coated & Special Steels’ Rs 183.06-crore IPO opens on October 29, 2026, with a price band of Rs 78–82 and an 11% grey market premium. The company reported 20% revenue growth and 7% profit growth in FY26. Anand Rathi recommends subscribing for long-term investment, citing reasonable valuation and growth prospects.

news.headline: Asian Paints Q2 Results: Net profit rises 7% YoY to Rs 1,068 crore; firm announces Rs 5.75/share dividend
news.summary: Asian Paints Q2 Results: The paint maker reported a 7% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 consolidated net profit to Rs 1,068 crore, while revenue grew 17% to Rs 9,977 crore. The company announced an interim dividend of Rs 5.75 per share, with November 4 set as the record date, even as shares fell 2%.

news.headline: Jio Platforms is becoming more than a telecom company: Dolat Capital
news.summary: Jio Platforms is poised to evolve beyond telecom as tariff hikes, 5G monetisation, home broadband and enterprise digital services drive its next growth phase, according to Dolat Capital. The brokerage initiated coverage with an Accumulate rating and a target price of Rs 1,435, citing strong growth prospects and rising free cash flow.

news.headline: HUL shares rise 3% after Q2 results. Jefferies, Nomura cut target price but forecast 29% upside potential
news.summary: Hindustan Unilever shares rose on Thursday after the FMCG major reported a 4% year-on-year increase in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 2,790 crore and 15% revenue growth to Rs 18,226 crore. Jefferies, Nomura and JM Financial cut their target prices but continue to see upside potential of up to 29%.
